description: This is a Java test class for the ThingsRoute component in an Eclipse Ditto-based application. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of HTTP routes related to 'things' management, such as creating, updating, and retrieving things and their attributes. The tests use the Akka Http TestKit framework and cover various HTTP methods and error scenarios.

classes.name: ThingsRouteTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the ThingsRoute component, verifying various HTTP endpoint behaviors related to 'things'.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by setting up the route with necessary dependencies.

methods.name: putNewThingWithAttributesSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests successful HTTP PUT request to create a new 'thing' with attributes.

methods.name: postFeaturesReturnsMethodNotAllowed
methods.description: Verifies that POST method to the features endpoint returns 405 Method Not Allowed.

methods.name: createThingWithInvalidInitialPolicy
methods.description: Tests creation of a thing with an invalid initial policy, expecting a BAD_REQUEST response.

methods.name: createThingWithInvalidInitialDefinition
methods.description: Tests creation of a thing with an invalid initial definition, expecting a BAD_REQUEST response.

methods.name: putPolicyIdAssumesJsonContentType
methods.description: Verifies that PUTting a policy ID with a non-JSON body returns an error, and with valid JSON returns success.

methods.name: putDefinitionAssumesJsonContentType
methods.description: Verifies that PUTting a definition with a non-JSON body returns an error, and with valid JSON returns success.

methods.name: putAndRetrieveNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests updating a thing's definition to null and retrieving it successfully.

methods.name: getThingsWithEmptyIdsList
methods.description: Tests behavior when requesting multiple things with an empty IDs list, expecting a BAD_REQUEST.

methods.name: getAttributesWithTrailingSlash
methods.description: Tests retrieving attributes with a trailing slash in the URL, expecting OK response containing specific type.

methods.name: getAttributesWithoutSlashButRandomText
methods.description: Tests behavior with an invalid attribute URL, expecting NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: putAttributeWithEmptyPointer
methods.description: Tests updating an attribute with an empty pointer, expecting BAD_REQUEST.

methods.name: putAttributeWithJsonException
methods.description: Tests updating an attribute with an invalid JSON number, expecting BAD_REQUEST.

methods.name: putAttributeWithJsonPointerException
methods.description: Tests updating attributes with a JSON pointer exception in the body, expecting BAD_REQUEST.
